refuter_finding.evidence: The page describes a unit L² vector 'whose modulus is invariant under all translations — and such an L¹ class vanishes almost everywhere'. The modulus has not been established to belong to L¹. For example, v(x)=(1/2)(1+|x|)^(-3/4) has L² norm one but nonintegrable modulus, showing that the unit-vector hypothesis supplies no such inclusion. The opened vanishing lemma explicitly supplies the valid bridge: 'apply the first statement to g=|v|²∈L¹'. The counterexample item uses that bridge correctly.
